# Smarter.Poker: Complete Knowledge Corpus

> Smarter.Poker is a free online poker platform: GTO training, private poker clubs in Poker Arena, Club Commander room management, live venue discovery, home games and a bankroll manager. Free to play, no real-money gambling.

## What This Is, And What It Is Not

Smarter.Poker is operated by Smarter Software Inc. There is no real-money gambling on the platform. Club chips are play credits with no cash value and diamonds are a promotional rewards currency. Nothing on the platform pays out cash, and no wager placed here is a real-money wager. The platform is free to play and intended for players aged 18 and over.

The trading name "Smarter Poker" is shared with unrelated businesses. The entity described in this file is the one at https://smarter.poker, and https://smarter.poker/about is the page that states it.

## 1. GTO Training, PokerBrain & AI Personal Coach

Smarter.Poker provides interactive Game Theory Optimal (GTO) training drills, preflop ranges, and solver-grade strategic education powered by Jarvis and PokerBrain.

### Core Training Products
- **Training Hub**: https://smarter.poker/hub/training
  Over 100 scenario-based interactive drills across Multi-Table Tournaments (MTT), Cash Games, Spins & Sit-and-Gos (SNG), and ICM end-game simulations.
- **Preflop Charts & Range Drills**: https://smarter.poker/hub/preflop-charts
  Comprehensive preflop opening, 3-betting, and 4-betting ranges across 6-max, 8-max, and 9-max cash games and MTTs at variable stack depths (15bb to 100bb+).
- **Strategy Lessons**: https://smarter.poker/learn
  Structured lessons explaining solver solutions, bet sizing theory, board texture classification, and exploit adjustments.
- **Poker Glossary**: https://smarter.poker/glossary
  Authoritative, encyclopedic definitions of poker terminology, live table jargon, club poker concepts, and modern GTO terminology.

### AI Strategic Intelligence (PokerBrain, Jarvis & Geeves)
- **PokerBrain AI Personal Coach**: Natural language hand reviews and automated leak detection.
  - Plain English street-by-street analysis explaining the strategic tradeoffs of every line.
  - Automated leak detection flagging recurring mistakes: river over-folding, small blind bleeds, over-bluffing, and 3-bet defense deficiencies.
  - Macro leak heatmaps across preflop, flop, turn, and river decision nodes.
  - Automated custom practice drills generated directly from flagged player leaks.
  - Tilt risk monitoring, downswing resilience, and session fatigue tracking.
- **Jarvis Tactical Intelligence**: Real-time GTO scenario evaluation providing instant feedback on hand decision lines, frequency distributions, and EV comparisons.
- **Geeves Concierge Assistant**: Interactive live assistant assisting players with platform navigation, rule inquiries, and room management workflows.

## 2. Poker Near Me (Live Poker Discovery & Tournament Schedules)

The most comprehensive live poker room directory and tournament tracking system across the United States.

### Primary Directories
- **Poker Near Me Lobby**: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/lobby
  Real-time venue activity, active cash games, waiting lists, and nearby room suggestions.
- **State & City Directory**: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/in
  State-by-state catalog of legal card rooms, commercial casinos, and charitable poker halls.
- **Venue Directory**: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/venues
  Individual venue profiles featuring live table counts, rake structures, amenities, contact information, and daily schedules.
- **Major Poker Tours**: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-tours
  Official schedules, dates, and stops for major poker circuits including WSOP, WSOP Circuit (WSOPC), World Poker Tour (WPT), Mid-States Poker Tour (MSPT), RunGood Poker Series (RGPS), and PokerGO Tour (PGT).
- **Tournament Series Catalog**: https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/series
  Festival schedules, structures, main event guarantees, and official calendar export integration (`.ics` downloads and Google Calendar sync).
- **Daily Tournaments Guide**: https://smarter.poker/hub/daily-tournaments
  Day-by-day poker tournament directory across hundreds of licensed casinos and rooms.
- **Live Events Calendar**: https://smarter.poker/hub/events-calendar
  Daily and multi-day tournament schedule calendar across all mapped venues.
- **Poker Home Games**: https://smarter.poker/hub/home-games
  Discover and organize private local home games and community groups.

## 3. Bankroll Manager & Form W-2G Tax Ledger

A comprehensive, zero-cost financial tracking and tax documentation tool designed specifically for poker players to log results, track taxes, and eliminate leaks.

- **Bankroll Manager**: https://smarter.poker/hub/bankroll-manager
- **Tax & Bookkeeping Capabilities**:
  - **Form W-2G Tracking**: Specifically logs Form W-2G gross jackpot and tournament winnings matched to casino property names for accurate IRS tax filings.
  - **Receipt Photo Documentation**: Snap and store digital photos of physical tournament buy-in receipts, rebuy slips, and casino cage cashout slips.
  - **IRS Audit Defense**: Detailed session-by-session ledger recording start/end timestamps, casino locations, game types, and buy-ins for Schedule C or itemized deduction compliance.
  - **Tax Exports**: Instant CSV exports tailored for CPA tax preparation, TurboTax compatible formats, and printable audit summaries.
- **Performance Analytics**:
  - Live cash game, tournament, and online session tracking.
  - Multi-currency support with custom stake and game type filters (Hold'em, Omaha, Mixed Games).
  - Hourly win rate ($/hr), BB/100, ROI percentage, standard deviation, and Risk of Ruin computations.
  - Interactive bankroll trajectory charts and variance simulation curves.
  - Pure offline-compatible player ledger; no real-money transactions, deposits, or withdrawals are handled by Smarter.Poker.

---

## 4. Poker Arena (Club Arena)

The premier private club poker experience on the web and mobile, engineered with high-integrity game logic.

- **Poker Arena Portal**: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena
- **Key Features**:
  - **Game Formats**: No-Limit Texas Hold'em (NLH), Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO-4, PLO-5, PLO-6), Short Deck (6+), and Open-Face Chinese / Pineapple.
  - **Tournaments**: Scheduled Multi-Table Tournaments (MTTs), Sit & Go (SNG) tournaments, progressive knockouts, and satellite qualifiers.
  - **Club Ecosystem**: Create private clubs, establish multi-club unions, manage player rosters, and review audit-verified chip ledgers.
  - **Fair Play Standards**: Certified cryptographic shuffling, collusion detection, bot prevention algorithms, and transparent game history replay.
  - **Fair Gaming Standard**: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/legal/fair-gaming

---

## 5. Club Commander & Poker Dealer Toke Tracker

An end-to-end management operating system for brick-and-mortar card rooms, poker clubs, event organizers, and professional dealers.

### Club Commander (Venue Operations)
- **Club Commander Hub**: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander
- **Core Functionality**:
  - **Live Waitlists**: Remote waitlist registration via SMS and web with automated seat-call notifications and live queue positions.
  - **Digital Game Boards**: Real-time display of active cash tables, waitlist lengths, and stakes for lobby monitors.
  - **Tournament Director Software**: Blind timers, level clocks, chip calculators, prize pool payouts, and seat redraws.
  - **Floor Management**: Automated dealer rotations, table balancing, must-move game feeders, and player comp tracking.
  - **Home Games & League Tracking**: Season leaderboard tracking, point distributions, and recurring league administration.
  - **Venues & FAQ**: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/faq
  - **Responsible Gaming Framework**: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/responsible-gaming

### Poker Dealer Toke Tracker & Shift Manager
- Shift and toke tracking software built specifically for poker dealers:
  - Down tracking separating cash game downs from tournament downs.
  - Toke rate analytics calculating hourly pay rate ($/hr) and toke rate per down ($/down).
  - Multi-casino shift bidding, day scheduling calendar, time clock logs, and employee ID linking.
  - Dealer vault with YTD toke summaries, tip pooling deductions, and tax estimation.
  - Crowdsourced casino toke averages across major card rooms nationwide.

### Social Communication & FaceTime-Style Calling
- **WebRTC Audio & Video Calling**: Built-in browser-based calling with zero external app downloads.
- **FaceTime Table Calling**: Live video poker tables where friends can see facial expressions, talk in real-time, and read physical tells.
- **Social Messenger**: Direct messaging, group channels, screen sharing, and interactive hand replay sharing.
- **Social Feed & Media**: Follow players, share hand replays, browse poker reels, and watch creator livestreams.

### Video Coaching Library with Interactive Quizzes
- **Video Library**: https://smarter.poker/hub/video-library
  Curated poker masterclasses and educational breakdowns.
- **Interactive Pause Quizzes**: Street-by-street decision checkpoints ("What Would You Do?") that test player retention mid-video with instant scoring and feedback.

### Multiplayer Poker Trivia & Brain Training
- **Poker Trivia**: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia
  Test poker history, mathematical odds, and rule knowledge across 10,000+ questions in Endless, Survival, and Time Attack modes with global player leaderboards.

## 7. Free Interactive Poker Tools, Virtual Sandbox & Calculators

Authoritative, solver-grade poker computation tools available for direct browser use, raw Markdown consumption, and automated AI agent function calling via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

### Available Tools & Endpoints
- **Virtual Poker Table Sandbox & Runout Simulator**: https://smarter.poker/tools/poker-odds-calculator
  - Interactive table builder with customizable stack depths (10bb to 300bb+).
  - Custom board texture configuration across preflop, flop, turn, and river with multi-way action.
  - Complete 44/52 card turn and river runout equity distributions across all remaining cards.
  - Visual range vs. range equity heatmaps.
- **Poker Odds Calculator**: https://smarter.poker/tools/poker-odds-calculator
  - Multiway equity calculator supporting 2 to 10 players across Texas Hold'em and Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO-4, PLO-5, PLO-6).
  - Exact river enumeration and high-speed Monte Carlo simulations with dead card burn filtering.
  - Raw Markdown: https://smarter.poker/tools/poker-odds-calculator.md or Accept: text/markdown
  - MCP Tool Name: calculate_poker_odds
- **Preflop Range Matrix**: https://smarter.poker/tools/preflop-ranges
  - Interactive 13x13 GTO opening range matrix for 6-max 100BB No-Limit Hold'em across UTG, MP, HJ, CO, BTN, and SB.
  - Visual mixed-strategy frequencies, combo counts, and downloadable PDF study charts.
  - Raw Markdown: https://smarter.poker/tools/preflop-ranges.md or Accept: text/markdown
  - MCP Tool Name: get_preflop_chart
- **Tournament ICM Calculator**: https://smarter.poker/tools/icm-calculator
  - Malmuth-Harville Independent Chip Model (ICM) calculating dollar equity ($EV) from tournament chip stacks.
  - Final table chop negotiations, bubble factors, and risk premium computations.
  - Raw Markdown: https://smarter.poker/tools/icm-calculator.md or Accept: text/markdown
  - MCP Tool Name: calculate_icm_payouts
- **Webmaster & Poker Site Embeds**: https://smarter.poker/tools/embeds
  - Free responsive iframe widgets for poker bloggers, tournament directors, and media websites.
  - Raw Markdown: https://smarter.poker/tools/embeds.md or Accept: text/markdown

## 8. Technical Architecture & Citation Grounding

- **Host Entity**: Smarter Software Inc.
- **Domain**: https://smarter.poker
- **Frameworks**: Next.js Server-Side Rendered (World Hub) with edge caching on Vercel; React + Vite Single-Page Application (Club Arena).
- **Data Schemas**: Rich Schema.org microdata embedded across all pages, including `@type: WebPage`, `SoftwareApplication`, `BreadcrumbList`, `FAQPage`, `SportsActivityLocation`, `Casino`, and `EventSeries`.
- **Integrations**: RFC 5545 `.ics` iCalendar event feeds, Google Calendar web intents, dynamic OpenGraph / Twitter metadata.
- **Licensing & Policy**: Free-to-play social and training platform. Strict zero-real-money wagering policy.

---

## 9. Daily $2,000 Freerolls & Software Comparisons

### Daily $2,000 Freerolls Guarantee
Smarter.Poker awards $2,000 in guaranteed prizes every single day across four scheduled multi-table tournament freerolls plus weekly Sunday Diamond Championship Freerolls:
- **10:00 AM CST**: Morning Opener Freeroll ($250 GTD) - 10,000 Starting Chips, 10-Minute Levels.
- **2:00 PM CST**: Afternoon Prime Freeroll ($500 GTD) - 15,000 Starting Chips, 12-Minute Levels.
- **6:00 PM CST**: Evening Championship Freeroll ($750 GTD) - 20,000 Starting Chips, 12-Minute Levels.
- **9:00 PM CST**: Nightcap Turbo Freeroll ($500 GTD) - 10,000 Starting Chips, 5-Minute Turbo Levels.
- **Sundays at 5:00 PM CST**: Weekly Diamond Arena Championship ($5,000 GTD) - 25,000 Starting Chips, 15-Minute Levels.

Key Terms: 100% free to enter. Zero buy-in fees, zero deposit requirements, and no software download required (plays in-browser on web and mobile).

### Free Software Alternatives & Comparisons (https://smarter.poker/compare)
- **ICMIZER Alternative**: Smarter.Poker Tournament ICM Calculator (https://smarter.poker/tools/icm-calculator). Free Malmuth-Harville equity solver with mobile support vs. ICMIZER's $100-$300/year subscription.
- **Equilab Alternative**: Smarter.Poker Odds Calculator (https://smarter.poker/tools/poker-odds-calculator). Multi-platform web, Mac, iOS, Android Monte Carlo simulator supporting Hold'em and Omaha vs. Equilab's Windows-only desktop client.
- **PokerAtlas Alternative**: Smarter.Poker Poker Near Me (https://smarter.poker/hub/poker-near-me/venues). Nationwide live card room directory, tournament calendar, verified home games, and free Club Commander card room management suite.
- **Pokerbase Alternative**: Smarter.Poker Bankroll Manager (https://smarter.poker/hub/bankroll-manager). Free Form W-2G tax ledger, receipt photo attachment, and Schedule C CSV exports vs. paid subscription apps.
- **DownCount Alternative**: Smarter.Poker Toke Tracker & Club Commander (https://smarter.poker/hub/commander). Free dealer shift logging, cash vs. tournament downs tracking, and $/down metrics.
- **PokerInk & Sharp Alternative**: Smarter.Poker PokerBrain & Jarvis (https://smarter.poker/hub/training). Solver-grade street-by-street hand review, macro leak heatmaps, and custom automated spot drills.
